confidence_notes: Holistic model estimates from general knowledge of Bratislava price levels, not from live listings or current menus. Restaurant and beer anchors are more reliable than accommodation, which varies more by season and property. The FX observation came from search-result summaries of RBA pages, which I could not read directly; the 15 October figure was the one both summaries agreed on.
comparable_city_reasoning: Benchmarked against lower-cost Central European capitals such as Brno, Ljubljana, and Budapest, and priced below Vienna, which is about an hour away by road.
